name: Cult Leader
ability: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.
designRole: Changes alignment based on an alive neighbour; a cult agreement can produce an immediate win for its alignment.
explanation: Changes alignment based on an alive neighbour; a cult agreement can produce an immediate win for its alignment.

nightInstructions.firstNight: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.
nightInstructions.otherNights: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon has the Cult Leader ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Cult Leader, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
